LanguageData.Raven_Projectile_RavenLiquidLasso.label: (Raven) Fluid Lasso
LanguageData.Raven_Weapon_RavenLiquidLasso.label: (Raven) Fluid Lasso
LanguageData.Raven_Weapon_RavenLiquidLasso.descriptio: A lasso loaded with viscous Raven fluid. Affected by the shooter's aim, a direct hit will only cause minor blunt damage but will quickly coat the target in Raven fluid; missing will spill a small patch of pink stains.
